title: Planning flags an item check that reads clone state a hand run can satisfy, and pairs it with a test of the code path
goal: From the SP-matmvkn6 close retrospective: ST-ihtjygip's check read the clone's refs/kb-reopened state, which the worker satisfied by calling the prune function by hand; the check passed while nothing proved close and drop call it (the review parked ST-6cp6uvmv). Planning names a check that reads clone or host state (refs, files outside the tree, a spool) and pairs it with a check that runs the code path the goal names.
